# @wthek/zod-express-interceptor

> Express middleware interceptor that transforms Zod validation errors into structured `http-error-kit` errors.

## Overview
`@wthek/zod-express-interceptor` acts as a bridge between Zod validation and Express error handling. It intercepts errors passed to `next(err)`, transforms any `ZodError` into a `KitHttpError` (retaining all validation issues), and forwards non-Zod errors untouched.

## Installation
```bash
npm install @wthek/zod-express-interceptor @wthek/zod-transformer @wthek/express-middleware http-error-kit http-response-status-code
```

## Quick Start
```typescript
import express from "express";
import { z } from "zod";
import { KitZodExpressInterceptor } from "@wthek/zod-express-interceptor";
import { KitExpressMiddleware } from "@wthek/express-middleware";

const app = express();
app.use(express.json());

const CreateUserSchema = z.object({
  email: z.string().email(),
  password: z.string().min(8),
});

app.post("/users", (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const data = CreateUserSchema.parse(req.body);
    res.status(201).json(data);
  } catch (error) {
    next(error); // Interceptor will convert ZodError to KitHttpError
  }
});

// 1. Intercept Zod errors and transform them to KitHttpErrors
app.use(KitZodExpressInterceptor());

// 2. Format and send all KitHttpErrors as structured JSON responses
app.use(KitExpressMiddleware());

app.listen(3000);
```

## API Reference

### `KitZodExpressInterceptor(options?: IKitZodTransformerOptions): ErrorRequestHandler`
Returns a 4-argument Express error-handling middleware: `(error, req, res, next) => void`.

#### Options (`IKitZodTransformerOptions`)
- `message` (`string`, default: `"Zod Validation Failed"`): Custom error message.
- `statusCode` (`number`, default: `400`): Custom HTTP status code.

## Safety Rules for AI Agents
1. In the Express middleware registration chain, always place `KitZodExpressInterceptor` BEFORE `@wthek/express-middleware`.
2. Forward validation errors via `next(error)` in synchronous catch blocks or async handlers.
3. Non-Zod errors pass through unchanged, allowing them to reach standard downstream error handlers.
